name: Chorus3
summary: A faithful modern rewrite of the Chorus2 Kodi web interface.
description: Chorus3 is a faithful rewrite of Chorus2 for current Kodi installations. It keeps the classic Chorus browsing, playback, remote, settings, add-on, playlist, PVR, and lab workflows while rebuilding the web interface with Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite, and direct Kodi JSON-RPC integrations.
